message:
chore(infra): filter git-courer metadata files from diff chunks

WHY
The previous filtering logic only excluded test files, allowing git-courer metadata files to be included in LLM context, which wasted tokens and introduced noise.

WHAT
* Renamed filterTestFiles to filterExcludedFiles and updated its logic to also skip metadata paths.
* Updated DiffChunker.Parse to call filterExcludedFiles instead of filterTestFiles.
* Modified line-by-line parsing logic to check for metadata paths alongside test file patterns.
* Added domain.IsMetadataPath check to the exclusion condition in multiple locations.
* Updated function documentation to reflect the new dual-filtering behavior.
author: Alejandro-M-P

message:
fix(core): add metadata directory path and path validation utility

WHY
The application lacked a defined constant for the git-courer metadata directory and had no utility to validate paths against it.

WHAT
* Defined the MetadataDir constant as ".git-courer" in the domain package.
* Implemented IsMetadataPath function to check if a path is the metadata directory or a subdirectory.
* Imported strings package to support prefix checking for path validation.
author: Alejandro-M-P
